> ## Verified statements
>
> - Electra CCO Keith Shuttlesworth said the 130,000 ft² Jefferson County, Colorado demonstration facility, opened ceremonially in October 2025, was on track to be **fully operational by Q3 2026**.
> - The facility's stated design output is **up to 500 tonnes per year** of low-carbon, high-purity iron. This is a design/target capacity, not a reported production run rate.
> - At the interview date Electra said it was making kilograms; demonstration output was intended for customer supply and qualification.
> - Nucor, Toyota Tsusho and INTERFER had advanced purchase agreements for demonstration-facility iron. These are qualification/commercial commitments, not completed material approvals.
> - Electra was still selecting a site for a first commercial facility. The CCO described an end-2029 readiness target and capacity up to 1 Mt/y; these are management forecasts before site selection, not FID or an approved construction schedule.
> - The article distinguishes the Q3 2026 full-operation target from the October 2025 facility opening/ribbon-cutting milestone.
>
> ## Interpretation boundary
>
> - The source is a trade-press interview quoting an Electra executive, not independent operating data.
> - “Fully operational by Q3 2026” supersedes the older “mid-2026 commissioning” target, but does not confirm that full operation had been achieved by July 2026.
> - The 1 Mt/y and end-2029 commercial target must remain an outlook, not a committed project schedule.
